description: Derived extractions for Sysmon (winlog.channel == 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational'): a native ECS mapping of its operational channel over the canonical winlog.* model, so Sysmon events land beside the other channels under one schema. Two steps: (1) classify event.category/type per Sysmon EventID; (2) project winlog.data.* onto ECS per EventID family — process create/terminate (1,5), process access/inject (8,10,25), network connection (3), DNS query (22), image/driver load (6,7), file create/delete/pipe (2,11,15,17,18,23,26), registry (12,13,14) — parsing the Hashes blob into process/file hash.* (+ pe.imphash) and the DOMAIN\user string into user.domain/user.name. The native winlog.data.* stays in place.

script.source: def id = ctx.winlog.event_id; def M = ['1':['process','start'],'2':['file','change'],'3':['network','connection'],'4':['configuration',null],'5':['process','end'],'6':['driver',null],'7':['library',null],'8':['process',null],'9':['process',null],'10':['process',null],'11':['file','creation'],'12':['registry','creation'],'13':['registry','change'],'14':['registry','change'],'15':['file','creation'],'17':['file','creation'],'18':['file',null],'22':['network',null],'23':['file','deletion'],'24':['file',null],'25':['process',null],'26':['file','deletion']]; def e = M.get(id); if (e != null) { if (!(ctx.event instanceof Map)) { ctx.event = [:]; } if (e[0] != null && ctx.event.category == null) { ctx.event.category = e[0]; } if (e[1] != null && ctx.event.type == null) { ctx.event.type = e[1]; } }

script.description: project Sysmon winlog.data.* onto ECS per EventID family; hash blob and DOMAIN\user parsed
script.source: def d = ctx.winlog.data; def id = ctx.winlog?.event_id; Closure real = { v -> v instanceof String && v.length() > 0 && v != '-' }; Closure put = { path, v -> if (real(v)) { def cur = ctx; for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) { if (!(cur[path[i]] instanceof Map)) { cur[path[i]] = [:]; } cur = cur[path[i]]; } if (cur[path[path.size() - 1]] == null) { cur[path[path.size() - 1]] = v; } } }; Closure hex = { v -> if (v instanceof String && v.length() > 0) { try { if (v.startsWith('0x') || v.startsWith('0X')) { return Long.parseLong(v.substring(2), 16); } return Long.parseLong(v); } catch (Exception e) { return null; } } return null; }; Closure pid = { path, v -> def n = hex(v); if (n != null) { def cur = ctx; for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) { if (!(cur[path[i]] instanceof Map)) { cur[path[i]] = [:]; } cur = cur[path[i]]; } if (cur[path[path.size() - 1]] == null) { cur[path[path.size() - 1]] = n; } } }; Closure hashes = { base, s -> if (s instanceof String && s.length() > 0) { for (def part : s.splitOnToken(',')) { int eq = part.indexOf('='); if (eq > 0) { def alg = part.substring(0, eq).toLowerCase(); def val = part.substring(eq + 1); if (val.length() > 0) { def p = new ArrayList(base); if (alg == 'imphash') { p.add('pe'); p.add('imphash'); } else { p.add('hash'); p.add(alg); } put(p, val); } } } } }; Closure setuser = { v -> if (v instanceof String && v.length() > 0 && v != '-' && !v.startsWith('%%')) { int ix = v.lastIndexOf('\'); if (ix >= 0) { put(['user','domain'], v.substring(0, ix)); put(['user','name'], v.substring(ix + 1)); } else { put(['user','name'], v); } } }; if (id == '1') { pid(['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.Image); put(['process','command_line'], d.CommandLine); put(['process','working_directory'], d.CurrentDirectory); put(['process','entity_id'], d.ProcessGuid); put(['process','pe','original_file_name'], d.OriginalFileName); hashes(['process'], d.Hashes); pid(['process','parent','pid'], d.ParentProcessId); put(['process','parent','executable'], d.ParentImage); put(['process','parent','command_line'], d.ParentCommandLine); put(['process','parent','entity_id'], d.ParentProcessGuid); setuser(d.User); } else if (id == '5') { pid(['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.Image); put(['process','entity_id'], d.ProcessGuid); } else if (id == '8' || id == '10') { pid(['process','pid'], d.SourceProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.SourceImage); put(['process','entity_id'], d.SourceProcessGuid); } else if (id == '25') { pid(['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.Image); } else if (id == '3') { put(['source','ip'], d.SourceIp); pid(['source','port'], d.SourcePort); put(['destination','ip'], d.DestinationIp); pid(['destination','port'], d.DestinationPort); pid(['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.Image); setuser(d.User); if (real(d.Protocol)) { if (!(ctx.network instanceof Map)) { ctx.network = [:]; } if (ctx.network.transport == null) { ctx.network.transport = d.Protocol.toLowerCase(); } } if (d.Initiated == 'true' || d.Initiated == 'false') { if (!(ctx.network instanceof Map)) { ctx.network = [:]; } if (ctx.network.direction == null) { ctx.network.direction = (d.Initiated == 'true') ? 'egress' : 'ingress'; } } } else if (id == '22') { put(['dns','question','name'], d.QueryName); pid(['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.Image); setuser(d.User); } else if (id == '6') { put(['file','path'], d.ImageLoaded); hashes(['file'], d.Hashes); } else if (id == '7') { put(['file','path'], d.ImageLoaded); hashes(['file'], d.Hashes); pid(['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.Image); } else if (['2','11','15','23','26'].contains(id)) { put(['file','path'], d.TargetFilename); pid(['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.Image); setuser(d.User); } else if (id == '17' || id == '18') { put(['file','name'], d.PipeName); pid(['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.Image); } else if (id == '12' || id == '13' || id == '14') { put(['registry','path'], d.TargetObject); pid(['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(['process','executable'], d.Image); }
